preamble: ^(?:(?:la|mi|nuestra) direccion(?: fisica)?(?: que (?:me|te|nos) dieron)? es|(?:lo|la) (?:encuentras|encontraras) en|(?:se encuentra|queda) en|my (?:physical )?address is|you (?:can|will) find it at)\s+
prompt:
Read one Puerto Rico physical address. Output only JSON. Use null for the entire response if there is no single numbered road, if kilometer figures conflict, or if the address requests a house or apartment number. A route may be written in words. In 'por la ochenta y uno', the main road is 81. A route with a barrio, sector, lot or interior can omit the kilometer. For this case return JSON null in the kilometer field. An explicit cross street is a landmark, not a second possible main road.
In a physical address like '3.5 Carr 100', the decimal is the kilometer. An unmarked whole number
beside a road can be a house number: do not assume it is a kilometer. Hectometers are tenths of
a kilometer. Read spoken Spanish numbers and English or Spanish address abbreviations.
Return the array [road, kilometer, locality, ZIP, interior, sector, landmark, lot, access]. Road is an integer. Write a stated kilometer as a decimal string. Locality contains the supplied barrio and municipio names in that order,
separated by a space, without labels. Keep a supplied place even when it seems wrong. Keep the five ZIP
digits including leading zeros. Interior is a boolean. Put sector or community names in sector without
the label, and other named sites, cross streets and directions in landmark, preserving the direction.
Keep every explicit solar, lote or lot identifier in lot. Write spoken lot numbers as digits. Interior is true for int. or interior. Put the supplied interior road name or number in access, without the label. A bare interior flag has empty access. Use an empty string for each absent text field. Never add a place, coordinate or number from memory.
Example: 'Km 3 hm 2 Interior, Ctra 81, Bo. Azul, Villa Ejemplo' -> [81,"3.2","Azul Villa Ejemplo","",true,"","","",""].
Example: 'Solar tres, sector Sol, Carr 81 km 3.2 Int. 7' -> [81,"3.2","","",true,"Sol","","3","7"].
Example: 'Sector Sol, interior 5, por la ochenta y uno, solar dos' -> [81,null,"","",true,"Sol","","2","5"].
